hivemindAdaptations: Keeps Higgsfield Cloud API and standard consumer Higgsfield CLI/dashboard as separate execution surfaces.
Requires Cloud/API requests to use HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_ID and HIGGSFIELD_API_KEY_SECRET through hive-env-run without printing secret values.
Requires one short Cloud API vs consumer CLI question when the user has not specified a surface.
Forbids procedural/local fallbacks when the user requests Higgsfield generation.
